newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU details clearance of Daimler deal.
newsitem.headline: EU details clearance of Daimler deal.

text.p: The European Commission said on Friday it had cleared plans by Daimler and Deutsche Telekom to form a venture, Telematik GmbH, in the area of traffic services.
Telematik will develop, establish, operate and market telematic services, which improve information and communication in traffic through data exchange between a service provider and automobiles.
Potential applications are in the areas of security, traffic guidance and planning, as well as in city, hotel, weather information and news.

"The market for these services is worldwide in an early technical and economical stage of development," the Commission said in a statement. "Exclusionary effects as a result of the combination of an automobile producer and a mobile phone system provider do not exist."
"The Commission has therefore decided to declare the operation compatible with the Common market and the EEA (European Economic Area) agreement," it added.
